items: You have one decision to make: should this change to the Claude Code settings file (.claude/settings.json) go in? Until you answer, it stays out. What happened: only the Investors may edit this file, so at 3:31 PM ET, at the end of a work session, the company's automatic file check put it back the way it was. A work session made this change (Idris, describing it as "settings: main-folder guard"). Approve makes the change shown below in .claude/settings.json (10 lines added, 0 removed), saved to GitHub from your own account. Disapprove keeps .claude/settings.json as it is now and records your answer. We recommend Disapprove unless you asked for this change, because work sessions may not edit these files.
Approve or Disapprove on Home > Issues, with your token saved.
Three days of widgets on your iPhone, then Export measurements (by 2026-11-12)
Blocked work waits on the Investors' answer; other work goes on meanwhile.
Decision: the app's public name, after one trademark search by you (by Mon 2026-11-02, Day 12)
Decision: two App Store Connect answers only you can give, web access and encryption (by Mon 2026-12-01)
Decision: approve PyWidget's voice once, so its later sentences need no card of their own (by Mon 2026-11-23)
